description: This file implements functionality for creating, serializing, and unwrapping TPM key blobs, including handling key attributes and enforcing security policies within the Android keymaster system. It interacts with TPM resources, serializable key components, and maintains system version information.

classes.name: TpmKeyBlobMaker
classes.description: Handles creation, serialization, and unwrapping of TPM key blobs with support for setting system version and patch levels.

methods.description: Creates a TPM key blob based on key attributes, origin, and key material, handling enforcement properties.

methods.description: Serializes key material and attributes into a secure blob after validation.

methods.description: Deserializes a key blob to extract key material, verifying integrity via HMAC.
